IMPORT strings.
FUNCTION totalWithTax(NUMBER amount, NUMBER ratePercent) {
    RETURN amount * (1 + ratePercent / 100).
} RETURNS NUMBER.
SENTENCE raw.
INPUT(raw).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(raw, " " ).
NUMBER amount = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER rate = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
DISPLAYNL(totalWithTax(amount, rate)).
